specialty_focus: KG is a global medical technology manufacturer based in Bayreuth, Germany. They develop and produce medical aids, advanced textiles, and orthopedic supports designed to improve patient mobility, clinical recovery, and quality of life. Cure Surgical Product Categories Compression Therapy: Medical circular- and flat-knit compression stockings, tights, and adjustable compression systems for venous and lymphatic disorders (like lymphedema and varicose veins).
